description.value: Coombs Country Candy is a candy and ice cream shop located in the small tourist village of Coombs on Vancouver Island, a popular stop along cycling routes between Parksville and Port Alberni. The shop sits on Old Nanaimo Highway in a community well-known for its quirky roadside attractions and artisan food stops. Touring cyclists passing through the area will find it a natural place to recharge with sweets.
